provenance: synthetic teaching cases; no runtime observations

cases.task: Predict a short-name lookup from another namespace.
cases.expected: It may search that namespace rather than the intended study service.

cases.task: State the configurable part of the FQDN.
cases.expected: The cluster domain is not universally cluster.local.

cases.task: Draw resolution and connection as separate phases.
cases.expected: DNS record, transport connection and application response have distinct evidence.

cases.task: Diagnose direct-IP success with name failure.
cases.expected: Investigate resolver configuration, DNS reachability and policy.

cases.task: Explain stale behavior after endpoint changes.
cases.expected: For a ClusterIP Service, existing connections keep their old backend because the name still resolves to the same virtual IP; for a headless Service, cached Pod address records can also send new connections to a removed Pod.

cases.task: Design robust service discovery for a client.
cases.expected: Known namespace/domain, bounded resolution/connection and safe reconnect behavior.
